title: Northern coalition under Jabin
english: [[Jabin king of Hazor gathers northern kings with many horses and chariots >> Bible:Joshua 11:1-5]]. They march to Merom’s waters. Pride and worldly pomp array against the church.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Hamstring the horses
english: The Lord: [[Hamstring their horses and burn their chariots >> Bible:Joshua 11:6]]. Do not trust horses. Our hope is the Lord, not the age’s weapons.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Hazor burned; land rests
english: [[He burns Hazor >> Bible:Joshua 11:10-13]]; other cities he leaves standing. [[The land rested from war >> Bible:Joshua 11:23]]. Complete victory begets rest. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).
